audiences.title: Dealers
audiences.body: Stock for your own lot, in the models that move fastest in your market. Consistent specification across a batch so your listings and your pricing stay simple.

audiences.title: Fleet operators
audiences.body: Identical units so your drivers learn one vehicle and your mechanics stock one set of parts. Livery and seating fitted before delivery.

audiences.title: Transport companies
audiences.body: Buses built for the route they will run, delivered in batches timed to when you actually put them on the road.

faqs.question: What counts as a wholesale order?
faqs.answer: Two units or more on most models, and five or more on new coupled units. The minimum for each unit is shown on its listing in the inventory.

faqs.question: Can I mix models in one order?
faqs.answer: Yes. Volume is counted across the order, not per model, so a mixed batch still qualifies. Delivery may be staged if the platforms have different lead times.

faqs.question: Do you deliver outside Lagos?
faqs.answer: Tell us where the units need to land and we will price it into the quote. [CONFIRM YOUR DELIVERY COVERAGE HERE.]

faqs.question: Can you fit our livery and seating before delivery?
faqs.answer: Yes. Livery, seating layout and interior finish are fitted during assembly, which is cheaper and cleaner than retrofitting after handover.

faqs.question: How do I get a quote?
faqs.answer: Send the form on this page with your company name, quantity and preferred models, or message the wholesale line on WhatsApp. Quotes are written, not verbal.

howItWorks.title: Tell us the quantity and the specification
howItWorks.body: Model, seat count, fuel and how many. If you are not sure which platform suits the route, tell us the route instead and we will advise.

howItWorks.title: We quote against the volume
howItWorks.body: Price per unit moves with quantity and with how much of the build is to your specification. You get a written quote, not a number over the phone.

howItWorks.title: Terms and schedule agreed
howItWorks.body: Payment terms and a delivery schedule are agreed before assembly starts, so both sides know what lands when.

howItWorks.title: Batch assembly
howItWorks.body: Units are coupled to one identical specification in the Okota workshop, and inspected at each stage of the build.

howItWorks.title: Delivery and handover
howItWorks.body: Units are road-tested, documented and handed over together, with papers complete for every unit in the batch.

wholesale.label: Dealers, fleets and transport companies
wholesale.title: Buying in volume
wholesale.intro: Wholesale is not a discount on the retail page. It is a different way of buying: units assembled to one specification, priced against quantity, and delivered against your route start date rather than whenever they happen to be ready.
